The basics

What is an Opus 5.5 video?

An Opus 5.5 video is a short animation written by Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic's latest Opus model. Instead of generating pixels like a diffusion video model, Opus 5.5 writes the video as code: canvas drawing, typography, 3D scenes and precise timing. That code is played back and recorded frame by frame into an MP4.

That's why an Opus 5.5 video is so good for motion graphics, product launches, app walkthroughs, explainers and data stories. Every letter is real type, every colour is exactly the one you asked for, and changing one scene doesn't reroll the rest of the video.

Making one used to mean setting up Claude, a render script and ffmpeg yourself. This Opus 5.5 video generator does it all in your browser: describe the video, watch the storyboard appear, refine it in chat, and download the MP4. No Claude subscription needed.

FAQ

Opus 5.5 video FAQ

What is the Opus 5.5 video generator?

opus6.video is an Opus 5.5 video generator. You describe the video you want, Claude Opus 5.5 plans a storyboard and writes every frame as code, and you refine it in chat and export an MP4, all in your browser.

Can Claude Opus 5.5 really make videos?

Yes, but not by painting pixels. Opus 5.5 writes the animation as code, and that code is played back and recorded frame by frame into an MP4. That's why text stays sharp, brand colours stay exact, and you can change one thing without regenerating the whole video.

Do I need a Claude subscription to make an Opus 5.5 video?

No. We run Claude Opus 5.5 for you. Pick a plan, describe the video, and download the MP4.

What kinds of Opus 5.5 videos can I make?

Product launch videos, app walkthroughs, motion design showreels, logo reveals, explainers, data stories, 9:16 social ads, 3D worlds and game moments like card reveals.

How long does an Opus 5.5 video take to make?

Usually a minute or two. The storyboard appears within seconds, then Opus 5.5 writes the code for each scene. Edits by chat usually take under half a minute.

How do I get a specific animation effect?

Pick it from the effect library. Each effect comes with exact wording and a technical recipe that we send to Opus 5.5, so you get the motion you saw instead of a guess.

Can Opus 5.5 edit a video I already have?

No. Opus 5.5 doesn't take video as input. It creates new videos from your description, text and brand details.

How long can an Opus 5.5 video be?

Up to 30 seconds per video, in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, exported as a 1080p MP4.

Can I use Opus 5.5 videos commercially?

Yes. Videos you create on opus6.video are yours to use, including in ads and client work.

Is opus6.video made by Anthropic?

No. opus6.video is an independent product built on Claude Opus 5.5. When newer Opus models ship, we'll add them.

基础知识

What is an Opus 5.5 video?

An Opus 5.5 video is a short animation written by Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic's latest Opus model. Instead of generating pixels like a diffusion video model, Opus 5.5 writes the video as code: canvas drawing, typography, 3D scenes and precise timing. That code is played back and recorded frame by frame into an MP4.

That's why an Opus 5.5 video is so good for motion graphics, product launches, app walkthroughs, explainers and data stories. Every letter is real type, every colour is exactly the one you asked for, and changing one scene doesn't reroll the rest of the video.

Making one used to mean setting up Claude, a render script and ffmpeg yourself. This Opus 5.5 video generator does it all in your browser: describe the video, watch the storyboard appear, refine it in chat, and download the MP4. No Claude subscription needed.

FAQ

Opus 5.5 video FAQ

What is the Opus 5.5 video generator?

opus6.video is an Opus 5.5 video generator. You describe the video you want, Claude Opus 5.5 plans a storyboard and writes every frame as code, and you refine it in chat and export an MP4, all in your browser.

Can Claude Opus 5.5 really make videos?

Yes, but not by painting pixels. Opus 5.5 writes the animation as code, and that code is played back and recorded frame by frame into an MP4. That's why text stays sharp, brand colours stay exact, and you can change one thing without regenerating the whole video.

Do I need a Claude subscription to make an Opus 5.5 video?

No. We run Claude Opus 5.5 for you. Pick a plan, describe the video, and download the MP4.

What kinds of Opus 5.5 videos can I make?

Product launch videos, app walkthroughs, motion design showreels, logo reveals, explainers, data stories, 9:16 social ads, 3D worlds and game moments like card reveals.

How long does an Opus 5.5 video take to make?

Usually a minute or two. The storyboard appears within seconds, then Opus 5.5 writes the code for each scene. Edits by chat usually take under half a minute.

How do I get a specific animation effect?

Pick it from the effect library. Each effect comes with exact wording and a technical recipe that we send to Opus 5.5, so you get the motion you saw instead of a guess.

Can Opus 5.5 edit a video I already have?

No. Opus 5.5 doesn't take video as input. It creates new videos from your description, text and brand details.

How long can an Opus 5.5 video be?

Up to 30 seconds per video, in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, exported as a 1080p MP4.

Can I use Opus 5.5 videos commercially?

是的。 Videos you create on opus6.video are yours to use, including in ads and client work.

Is opus6.video made by Anthropic?

No. opus6.video is an independent product built on Claude Opus 5.5. When newer Opus models ship, we'll add them.
